description: This file defines React components for image-related toolbar tools in the Notesnook editor, including image alignment, properties popup, and settings menu.

methods.name: ImageSettings
methods.description: Renders image settings tools in the toolbar if an image is active and toolbar is at the bottom.

methods.name: ImageAlignLeft
methods.description: Button to align selected image to the left.

methods.name: ImageAlignRight
methods.description: Button to align selected image to the right.

methods.name: ImageAlignCenter
methods.description: Button to center align the selected image.

methods.name: ImageProperties
methods.description: Button and popup for editing image properties.
